Embedding test

A fake article column. The first figure is the piece's own file in an iframe, the second and third are inline mounts of the same module (two copies on one page, different seeds), and none of them may fetch anything beyond the files named here.

Scroll past a figure and its canvas stops drawing (see the log, bottom right). Scroll back and it resumes from the page clock, so the loop phase stays consistent.
